attributes.board_name: Washington State Department of Health (Dental Hygiene Program)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses offered or authorized by recognized organizations (e.g. WSDA, ADA, NDA, WDHA, ADHA, NDHA and components; AHA, OSHA/WISHA training), institutions of higher learning; distance learning with an assessment counts. Department does not approve specific courses. Practice management max 5 h/year.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Annual CE applies to each year following the first license renewal.
rules.audit_note: Signed declaration at annual renewal; random audit of up to 25% after renewal.

topics.who: One-time training from the DOH model list, in the first full reporting period after licensure
Current BLS for health care providers

rules.notes: License renews every year on the birthday. Current BLS for health care providers required.
